tests.reason: Select original cases by checked exact names and retain every assertion. The original JavaScript scripted fixture, closures and counters execute through a callback relay to FxDurableAgent<JSONValue, JSONValue>; Swift owns scheduling, leases, atomic journal marks, persistence and replay. Upstream pure log helpers remain fixture utilities and do not qualify Swift behavior. FxAgentRouter owns cross-agent forwarding; agents with distinct names on one store share a driver connection while callbacks remain scoped to their agent tokens. The JavaScript settings hook converts fixture options into native JSON settings persisted separately from context.
tests.status: partial: 25 selected original memory cases pass through Swift, covering replay and exported checkpoints, delivery yields with each step once, two-agent ordering, separate named agents' own sessions, message deduplication, refusal before any record, stopped-executor replacement, bounded stop and engine-open retries, cancellation of repeatedly stopped turns, recovery after engine-open outages, session halting, late end records, caller context and session settings retained across resumed turns, own-signal cancellation, image-shaped JSON retry and getter evaluation, preallocated session identity, and next input starting before terminal cleanup ends. Two additional original named-forwarding cases pass, one memory and one local, through FxAgentRouter and the shared driver transport. Exact memory selections are in generic-core.mjs; generic-core-results.json records exit 0, no signal and empty stderr. The named-forwarding selections are in generic-routing.mjs. Explicit completed marks commit atomically with opaque records and remain in the native snapshot after compaction. The separate generic-fresh-host companion kills host and driver after terminal append acknowledgement, then verifies no completed prompt or step executes in a fresh process; exported history and subsequent work remain correct. This companion is additional proof and is not counted as another original case. Wake handlers, full World integration, public route and queue fault hooks, and remaining original cases are pending. The local named-forwarding case qualifies Swift routing; it does not qualify World lifecycle or public route hooks. Native and independent public-consumer proofs remain separate from these selected upstream assertions. Direct native RouterReplicaTests qualifies compatible named workers on independent SQLite connections; this is separate from unexecuted original World route assertions.

The two added local delivery cases cover acceptance immediately before a host crash and recovery of a non-idempotent send without sending twice; durable-additions-results.json records all four additions exiting 0 with no signal and empty stderr. One additional original local save-crash case passes with stable execution identity through the Swift driver, recorded separately in generic-durable-additions-results.json. The active-executor settled/flush bridge is now implemented and the original lookup-crash case passes, as recorded in the later qualification below. Generic external durability and remaining scenarios are pending; an earlier combined run failed queued-turn cancellation once; 100 normal reruns, twenty Address Sanitizer reruns and a subsequent 90/90 combined runner pass without explaining that failure, so its cause remains open. Public injectable host storage has native and independent-consumer proof, and the host queue contract has native and independent HTTP consumer proof. Complete upstream forwarding, World and queue fault scenarios, remote database/queue service integrations and remaining original cases remain pending. Later qualification: the active-executor flush bridge is implemented; original local lookup-crash and save-crash, input/tool/steered image persistence, and eight text/image steer-start cases pass through Swift. generic-durable-steer-start.mjs retains original assertions, but does not implement the supplied JavaScript World queue descriptor. The full selected compatibility runner passes 103/103. Native SessionLeaseTests and AgentLeaseTests qualify timed renewal, noncooperative renewal expiry, fenced takeover and recovery without repeating a completed non-idempotent effect. OpeningRetryTests qualifies bounded transient stored-image read recovery. IntakeCancellationTests qualifies pre/postcommit cancellation for prompt and steer. These are direct Swift contracts; full World/provider coverage is not claimed. DurablePlacementTests and DurableVisibilityTests add direct native proof for waiting-prompt steering placement, idle cancellation, duplicate wakeups, rejected-input ID reuse, checkpointed steering, early subscriptions, completion without another journal read and bounded checkpointed worker loads across 128 turns. Eight test functions pass normally and under both sanitizers; they are not counted as original World cases.
